Touch: left stick down = descend, up = climb; sideways = yaw. Right stick = pitch / roll. Release to level and hold altitude. Counter-steer to brake.

Ocean: choose FREE FLIGHT and OFFSHORE in SETUP, then START FLIGHT. ALT is height above ground or mean sea level. HOME points to the airfield. Water contact ends the flight. Course finish unlocks free flight. Areas are connected across the island; relocation is optional. Simulated flight and video. No hardware connection.
